summary: A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocacy groups mark anniversaries of federal interventions in the District—including a National Guard deployment and a federal takeover—to argue for the urgency of statehood. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
